title: Doler & Health Consolidation
goal: Review doler, body parts, indirect objects, pharmacy vocabulary, and physical sensations.

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can use duele vs. duelen correctly with singular and plural body parts.
I can use indirect object pronouns (me, te, le, nos, les) with doler.
I can communicate symptoms and ask for remedies at a pharmacy.

sections.title: Can you do this?
